## 1. Spiritual & Pilgrimage Tour Packages (Yatras)
Spiritual and sacred circuits across India's most revered temples and destinations:

- [Char Dham Yatra Package (10 Days)](https://www.onlyroadtrip.com/char-dham-yatra-package): Delhi - Yamunotri - Gangotri - Kedarnath - Badrinath

- [Kashi Yatra Package](https://www.onlyroadtrip.com/kashi-yatra-package): Varanasi (Kashi Vishwanath) temple tours
- [Ayodhya Yatra Package](https://www.onlyroadtrip.com/ayodhya-yatra-package): Shri Ram Mandir and Ayodhya sacred tour
- [Jyotirlinga Yatra](https://www.onlyroadtrip.com/jyotirlinga-yatra): Major Shiva temple circuits in India
- [Dwarka – Somnath Premium Pilgrimage](https://www.onlyroadtrip.com/packages/dwarka-somnath): Gujarat sacred tour
- [Varanasi, Ayodhya, Prayagraj & Gaya Tour](https://www.onlyroadtrip.com/packages/varanasi-ayodhya-prayagraj-gaya-bodh-gaya): Complete eastern spiritual circuit
- [Amarnath Yatra via Kashmir](https://www.onlyroadtrip.com/packages/amarnath-yatra-kashmir): Holy cave pilgrimage with Kashmir tour
- [Vaishno Devi Group Yatra](https://www.onlyroadtrip.com/packages/vaishno-devi-group-yatra): Holy shrine of Mata Vaishno Devi in Jammu
- [Mathura, Vrindavan & Barsana](https://www.onlyroadtrip.com/packages/mathura-vrindavan-barsana): Braj Bhoomi spiritual escape
- [Tirupati Balaji Tour](https://www.onlyroadtrip.com/packages/tirupati-tirumala): Premium Tirumala temple visits
